title: Global Sonner toaster + toasts for availability submit and leaderboard rank improvements

requirements.summary: Mount a single global Sonner Toaster at the app root so existing toast calls render on all routes.
acceptanceCriteria: A toast container (Sonner `Toaster`) is mounted once at the app layout/root level so toasts render on all routes.
Existing `toast.*` calls (e.g., on Leaderboard and Day Detail pages) display visible toasts without requiring per-page setup.

file_operations.description: Import and mount Sonner's `Toaster` once within the root layout tree (e.g., inside `Layout` alongside `Background`/`AppLayout`) so `toast.*` calls from any route render globally.

requirements.summary: Show success/error toasts for Add Availability submit results before navigating away.
acceptanceCriteria: On successful submission in `frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.tsx`, show a success toast (English text) before navigating away (e.g., “Availability added” or “Availability updated”).
On mutation error, show an error toast with a sensible fallback message in English.
The toast triggers exactly once per successful submit.

file_operations.description: Use `toast` from `sonner` to display (1) a success toast on `useAddAvailability` mutation success (choose text based on whether `existingAvailability` is present), then navigate; and (2) an error toast in `onError` with an English fallback message. Ensure submit remains disabled while pending so the success toast fires once per successful submit.

requirements.summary: Detect and toast when the caller’s leaderboard rank improves after refreshes (not on initial load).
acceptanceCriteria: When viewing `frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx`, the app detects the caller’s rank based on their position in the `useGetLeaderboard()` results.
If the caller’s rank improves compared to the previous observed rank during the same page session, show a success/info toast in English (e.g., “You moved up to #3”).
No “rank improved” toast is shown on the initial leaderboard load (only on subsequent updates).
No toast is shown when the rank stays the same or worsens.

file_operations.description: Add page-session rank tracking (e.g., `useRef` for previous rank + a flag for initial observation) and a `useEffect` that recomputes the caller’s rank from `useGetLeaderboard()` results; if the new rank number is smaller than the previously observed rank (and not the first observation), show a Sonner toast like “You moved up to #X”. Do not toast on initial load or when rank is unchanged/worse.
